info.title: Email Draft Approval API
info.description: Agents create, revise and submit email Drafts; a human Reviewer approves or rejects the submitted Revision in the Review UI, and an Approval sends the email through Resend. Every route except this document requires a bearer token. Errors use the `ErrorResponse` envelope.

agentAuth.description: The Agent token (`agent_…`), shared by every Agent.

reviewerAuth.description: The Reviewer token (`reviewer_…`), held by the human Reviewer only.

requestId.description: The request's id, also sent as the `X-Request-Id` header
